name: NAS Electronics
old_description: Electronics manufacturing is our core competency and has been for over thirty years. about:
NAS Electronics operates from Henderson, Nevada, where it has provided electronics manufacturing services for over three decades. The company does not disclose a precise founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in its public materials.

The shop specializes in printed circuit board assembly and related box-build work. It offers turnkey assembly, consignment assembly, final device assembly, and cable assembly, supported by a design-for-manufacturability (DFM) process that aims to prevent, detect, quantify, and eliminate waste. Inspection capabilities include automated optical inspection (AOI) and X-ray. The company describes its range as spanning quick-turn PCB runs to multi-year manufacturing programs, though it does not publish facility size, headcount, annual volume, or part-number counts.

NAS Electronics serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) across North America. Testimonials reference builds involving LGA156 packages, assembled cables, and complete device integration, but no specific vertical markets such as medical, aerospace, or automotive are called out.

The company states it is driven to provide exceptional product quality and an unmatched experience, positioning its team as consultants who look out for the customer's best interest at every step. It also highlights long-standing supplier partnerships that yield competitive component pricing.
